description: Annotated 'Q proof' collage arguing that Q's posts correlate with Department of Defense tweets. Numbered markers (1-3), arrows and highlights link the elements; a header claims this timing proves Q is a genuine 'White Hat'. A commenting tweet's username is blacked out.

description: Official photograph of Kim Jong-un standing centered with five South Korean officials in dark suits, posed in a hall before a large orange sunrise-over-sea mural. It matches the widely published photo of the South Korean special delegation's meeting with Kim in Pyongyang on March 5 2018; the men flanking Kim are consistent with National Security Office head Chung Eui-yong and NIS Director Suh Hoon. The image bears the watermark of Cheong Wa Dae (the Blue House), the South Korean presidential office.
text: THE REPUBLIC OF KOREA. CHEONG WA DAE
flags: Chung Eui-yong and Suh Hoon identified from the well-known published context of this photo, not from in-image captions; probable not certain
Location/date (Pyongyang, March 5 2018) inferred from context, not shown in the image
Remaining three delegation members not identified

description: Meme placing two official North Korean photographs side by side above the caption 'WATCH THE WATER. Q'. Left: Bill Clinton seated beside Kim Jong-il with a delegation standing behind them in front of a green ocean-wave mural, matching the August 2009 Pyongyang photo from Clinton's trip to secure the release of two detained U.S. journalists. Right: Kim Jong-un posed with the South Korean delegation before an orange sunrise-over-sea mural, matching the March 2018 Pyongyang meeting photo. The meme implies Q's 'watch the water' phrase refers to the water murals used as backdrops in such photos.
flags: The 'watch the water' connection between the murals and the Q phrase is the meme's unverified interpretive claim
Delegation members standing in both photos not identified

description: Screenshot of the header page of a declassified CIA Information Report, approved for release 2009/05/01 under document number CIA-RDP80-00810A004000690005-7. The 1954 report, marked SECRET/CONTROL - U.S. OFFICIALS ONLY, concerns the Red October Steel Plant in Stalingrad, USSR; several fields are redacted (blank boxes marked 25X1). The visible first line of body text notes the plant was obliterated during World War (cut off). In the Q context the document is used for the 'Red October' phrase.
